freeze.policy: Fixed weights: same observation plus its exact transpose; equal averaging, no fit, clipping or phase selection.
freeze.benchmark: Three warmups, seven interleaved32-input runs, CPU4threads, original vs two-view average.

limits: All procedural controls already consulted; no new reserved or photographic validation.
Two forward passes, not a new trained checkpoint or production integration.
Equivariance alone does not prove better reconstruction, denoising or perceptual quality.
CPU timing on128px inputs cannot predict full-definition RAW or GPU latency.

timing.scope: CPU128x128 synthetic inputs, includes coordinate transforms/projection, excludes I/O/hashes/metrics; not full RAW latency.
